name: Weasel Den
description:
Weasel Den is a growing suite of small, consumer product AI tools (we call them weasels) under one subscription. Each product does one job well, and every one is included with your membership.

The first is Receipt Weasel: price protection on autopilot. Share your receipt (a photo, or just say what you bought) and it tracks each item's price twice a day. When a price falls inside the store's price-adjustment window, it tells you exactly what the store owes you and by when, so you claim the refund before the window closes.

What you can do:
- Submit receipts by photo or by describing what you bought
- Track the items you choose for price drops
- Ask anytime whether you're owed money: see paid vs. current price and the refund deadline per store policy
- Do it all in plain language; clean cards show results at a glance

One membership, the whole den: $4.99/month or $49.99/year (two months free) unlocks every product we ship, today and in the future. When a new tool joins the den, it's simply included. Your subscription gets more valuable over time and never splinters into per-product pricing. Weasel Estates (get your estate in order) is live now and connects to the same den account; more tools are on the way. The only extras are optional power add-ons, like Amplified Tracking (100 tracked items instead of 25).

Start free: a 30-day trial begins on first use, no card required, with up to 5 tracked items.

Your data stays yours: we read only what a price adjustment needs (merchant, items, prices, dates), encrypt it in transit and at rest, and never sell or share it. Privacy policy: weaselden.ai/privacy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Weasel Den to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Weasel Den to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.weaselden.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Weasel Den MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weasel Den provides these MCP tools: check_price_drops, confirm_receipt, get_receipt, get_started, link_weasel_estates, list_receipts, set_line_item_product, submit_receipt, submit_receipt_details, track_items, and weaselden_home.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Weasel Den?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Weasel Den in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Weasel Den MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weasel Den requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Weasel Den is developed by Weasel LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
